fullPassage: In an experiment conducted by Antoine Bechara, participants were given $2,000 in play money and four decks of cards and were told that they were to use them in a game. Different individual cards won or lost different sums of money. They should just go ahead and turn the cards and try to win as much money as they could. But the cards were not random. In fact, some of the piles were far more profitable than others. On average, it took the gamblers around fifty card-turns before they began to report a conscious 'hunch' that some of the decks were more profitable. But when their behaviour was analysed, Bechara discovered something remarkable. Measurements of the electrical conductance of their skin, which can reveal levels of anxiety and nervousness, indicated that their emotions were subtly warning them against the bad decks after just ten turns. Their unconscious mind had worked out what was happening far quicker than their conscious minds and had warned them with a hit of bad feeling. They knew before they knew.

ch: Antoine Bechara가 수행한 실험에서 참가자들에게 네 벌의 카드 덱이 주어졌다.

questions.passage: In an experiment conducted by Antoine Bechara, participants were given $2,000 in play money and four decks of cards and were told that they were to use them in a game. Different individual cards won or lost different sums of money. They should just go ahead and turn the cards and try to win as much money as they could. But the cards were not random. In fact, some of the piles were far more profitable than others. On average, it took the gamblers around fifty card-turns before they began to report a conscious 'hunch' that some of the decks were more profitable. But when their behaviour was analysed, Bechara discovered something remarkable. Measurements of the electrical conductance of their skin, which can reveal levels of anxiety and nervousness, indicated that their emotions were subtly warning them against the bad decks after just ten turns. Their unconscious mind had worked out what was happening far quicker than their conscious minds and had warned them with a hit of bad feeling. They knew before they knew.

det.korean: ① taking → took: 가주어 it 구문(It took ~ before...)에서 주절 동사 과거형 took이 필요. taking(현재분사)은 주절 동사 불가 / ② analysed → 수동태 과거분사 정상 / ③ warning → 진행형(were warning) 정상 / ④ worked → 과거완료(had worked) 정상
det.analysis:
✅ ① taking(오류): 'it taking the gamblers around fifty card-turns' — 가주어 it 구문. 주절 동사 took(과거형) 필요. taking은 분사로 동사 역할 불가 ← 정답
❌ ② analysed: 'their behaviour was analysed' — 수동태(be + p.p.) 정상
❌ ③ warning: 'their emotions were subtly warning them' — 과거진행형(were + V-ing) 정상
❌ ④ worked: 'Their unconscious mind had worked out' — 과거완료(had + p.p.) 정상
det.tip: It took + 시간 + before ~ = ~하기까지 (시간)이 걸렸다. took이 주절 동사.
